purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Tula-region BTI sources evidence cadastral-work and cadastral-valuation activity and reference NSPD/Rosreestr channels. No anonymous safe parcel-ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: The official regional BTI is a local/regional cadastral-work and valuation institution, while Rosreestr/Roskadastr and NSPD are the federal registration/spatial-data channels. This establishes custodian/procedure evidence for Tula-region cadastral work, not a separate open Tula parcel API and not source integration.
